# Hardening test inventory

Baseline: `bf795979aca67df1cf83b7c96d8c2990b5266808`. Current suites: **117 backend + 30 mobile + 15 chart = 162 unique cases**, versus 42 + 9 + 2 at baseline. Backend executes on both SQLite and PostgreSQL; those are two executions of the same 117 cases. Fixtures mock official provider SDKs and never use paid provider credentials.

## Added backend tests

Names below include parameterized cases in the full collection further down. Existing Arabic E2E now also executes the `worker-restart` variant; the native voice mock was corrected so exceptions cannot be swallowed by its async context manager.

## Mobile cases (complete suite)

Added coverage includes attachments, activity failures, durable run states, notification dedupe/deep links, streaming reconnect, and voice cancellation/reconnect/research failure.

### App.test.tsx

- `Arabic welcome has drawer navigation and no chart button`
- `English welcome and localized navigation`
- `Arabic composer renders streaming event envelopes`
- `direction and mixed symbol isolation ar`
- `direction and mixed symbol isolation en`
- `recommendation omits absent prices and confidence`
- `selection artifact sends structured interaction to backend`
- `chart bridge rejects unknown commands`
- `settings starts with no keys or invented model choices`
- `attachment preview, progress and removal in ar`
- `attachment preview, progress and removal in en`
- `composer sends uploaded attachment IDs and a real queued state`
- `failed upload stays selected with a clear retry message`
- `tool failures render safe failure activity, without arguments`

### CallView.test.tsx

- `unmount after reconnect stops the replacement voice session`
- `closing an incoming call during authorization never starts its microphone`

### Voice.test.ts

- `disconnect offers reconnect and stop cancels server session and microphone`
- `missing session identity fails safely`
- `cancel while permission is pending never opens microphone`
- `duplicate research events are deduped and failed research is handled`

### Notifications.test.ts

- `privacy and channel behavior normal`
- `privacy and channel behavior urgent`
- `privacy and channel behavior call`
- `persistent receipt suppresses duplicate display`
- `deep-links exact recommendationId`
- `deep-links exact taskId`
- `deep-links exact sessionId`
- `decline dismisses and never starts a call`
- `accept routes incoming call with its source conversation`

### Streaming.test.ts

- `authenticated reconnect replays from the last event and drops duplicates`
